title: CraftVenture
description: CraftVenture is the ultimate exploration & adventure modpack designed for players who want a fresh, exciting Minecraft journey without overwhelming complexity.
body:
🌍 CraftVenture – Explore. Build. Conquer.

CraftVenture is a carefully curated Fabric modpack that transforms Minecraft into a true adventure experience.
Explore stunning landscapes, raid dangerous dungeons, and build amazing contraptions — solo or with friends!

✨ Features

🌄 Stunning World Generation
Powered by Terralith and YUNG’s Better Structures for endless exploration.

⚔️ Adventure & Exploration
Dungeons, ruins, towers, and hidden loot keep every journey exciting.

⚙️ Creativity & Automation
Use Create to build contraptions, machines, and automate your base.

🎮 Quality of Life Tweaks
Inventory sorting, gravestones, minimap, and performance optimizations.

👥 Multiplayer Friendly
Fully server-compatible — play with friends without extra setup.

📦 Included Mods (Highlights)

Terralith – Gorgeous biomes & terrain

YUNG’s Better Dungeons/Strongholds/Nether Fortresses – New structures

Create – Machines & automation

Gravestones – Recover your items when you die

JourneyMap or Xaero’s Minimap – Map & waypoint system

Cloth Config / Architectury / Fabric API – Required libraries

(Full modlist included in the pack.)

🖥️ Server Pack Included

This pack includes a server version, so you can easily host a CraftVenture server for you and your friends.
Just unzip, edit eula.txt, and run start.bat!

🎯 Goal

CraftVenture is designed to keep Minecraft fresh, challenging, and rewarding — perfect for explorers, builders, and redstone engineers who want a true adventure without overwhelming complexity.
